posts.title: Reflecting on 2025
posts.description: Not quite sure what happened this year but I definitely feel like it was momentous. In no particular order: Traveled to China for the first time. Got to see Shanghai and met my wife’s extended family. Grew my following on social media considerably. Mainly in Threads which somehow surprises people as a place that exists. Earned 4 figures on an app I built. Which gave me validation to try new ideas
